## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set, second model and all 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal >99%, Benign <1% | Strongly one class |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at α=0.1 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Not flagged despite blur |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; lower invasive association [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Score typical, not elevated · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Score typical, not elevated · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Score well below typical; spot check 12/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 4) · context · Typical score; spot check 8/20 [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test +0.54 logit vs random (CI 0.47–0.60) excludes 0; faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion test +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Unreliable concepts (mitoses, necrosis, normal lobules) are not cited above.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is blurred (severity 3); reliability score only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87).
- Conformal 90% guarantee is dataset-level (measured coverage 92%), not a per-case probability.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 3, 9** · Highest heatmap contributions toward invasive (near zero); confirm no invasive or in-situ focus.
2. **Region 7** · Highest per-region invasive probability (7%); check for focal atypia under blur.
3. **Region 4** · Top region for pleomorphism (Validated) and TILs (Weak); confirm nuclei look benign.
